_note: Strings for the /home redesign — the 'needs you' band and the captions on the product shelf. One file, every language, folded into the base bundles by i18n/index.ts. Odia is deliberately absent for the same reason as _new_ui.json: an unreviewed Odia draft spoken to someone who cannot read it is worse than honest English in an English voice, and resolve() already falls back correctly. Add `or` here only after a native speaker has checked it.

en.home.todo_orders_sub: Someone has bought. Pack and send
en.home.todo_pay_sub: Tell us if it reached your bank
en.home.todo_colour_sub: These cannot be sent to shops yet
en.home.todo_setup_sub: Add your bank details to get paid
en._flag_note: Shorter than home.todo_colour on purpose — it has a 2-column tile to fit in beside an icon, where the row version has the full screen width. Same meaning, imperative rather than descriptive, because on the tile it is next to the thing you would act on.
